text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the modern workplace. One of its biggest impacts is through automation, which handles repetitive tasks like data entry and scheduling. This shift frees up employees to focus on more creative and strategic work. Meanwhile, productivity tools powered by AI help workers analyze large amounts of information quickly, draft emails, and manage projects more efficiently. However, the rise of AI does not mean humans become obsolete. Instead, the future relies on human-AI collaboration, where people guide the technology with judgment and empathy. While some jobs will change or disappear, new roles will emerge, requiring workers to learn new skills and adapt to working alongside intelligent machines.
